comment: Built-in presets, shipped read-only. User presets live in the data directory and are merged over these at load time. See the note on the layer block below.

presets.name: 重庆全域
presets.description: D:\Map 基线所用的窗口：N28-N32 与 E105-E110 的 30 幅 GLO-30 分幅。
presets.layer_note: Only the free-text fields are preset. Everything else in layer.json is either fixed by the format -- tilejson 2.1.0, format heightmap-1.0, scheme tms, tiles {z}/{x}/{y}.terrain, extensions [watermask] -- or derived from the actual data: bounds from the raster extent and minzoom/maxzoom from the tile directory. Presetting those would let a preset disagree with the file it describes, which is what NFR-06 forbids.
